# <span id="aanchor86"></span> <span id="aanchor87"></span> Unit Assignment

Use the System Unit Assignment screen to view the default units that FLOWCAL uses for meter calculations if you do not define units at the meter level. Most meters do not have units defined at the meter level. FLOWCAL also uses the system units to calculate standard conditions.

Unit assignments are datetime effective. If multiple records exist in the database, use the buttons below the **Edit Effective From** and **Effective To** fields to scroll through the records.

You cannot edit historical values, but you can create a new set of units.

System units are useful in balancing and reporting. If gas meter 1 reports volume to FLOWCAL in hundred cubic feet (Ccf) while the remaining meters report in thousand cubic feet (Mcf), FLOWCAL calculates the volume for gas meter 1 in both Ccf and Mcf and stores both values in the database for more accurate calculations.

<div class="procedure">

To access the System Unit Assignment screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the System group, select **Unit Assignment**.
